tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bhagawām̐st+risamayabyūharādzñsādhanānudzñāsopadeshabiharatisma//

༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wām̐ sti sa ma ya byū ha rā dzñā sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// lha sngags cho ga'i cha shas yongs gang 'od dkar can// 'da' bar mi bya dam tshig gsum bkod zla ba ni// rtse gcig bsnyen las dngos grub zil dngar mchog thob phyir// dad pas btud de sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i shing rta dbye// skal bzang gang zhig srid las nges par 'byung ba dang snying rje chen pos yid rang dbang med par bskyod de mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub par 'dod pas/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba mnos nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i kun spyod la yang dag par gnas te/ gtsang zhing dben la yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i sgrub pa'i khang par ku sha la sogs pa'i stan 'jam po la nye bar 'dug ste khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// de la thog ma kho nar rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar bltas la/ mtha' yas 'jig rten khams rnams na// ji snyed rgyal ba sras bcas la// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis// kun nas bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag byas te skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces dang*/ lus can rnams kyi byang chub phyir// yang dag byang chub sems bskyed nas// sems can kun la sman 'gyur phyir// bzang po spyod pa spyad par bgyi// zhes lan gsum sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas khrus dang*/ bgegs bsal ba dang*/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i bya ba sogs rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams las rgya cher 'byung na'ang*/ 'dir sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i spyi 'gro ltar spros pa mdor bsdus pa'i dbang du byas nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang skad cig gis thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trai yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/lan gsum/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus shing*/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du nges pas drangs te de kho na nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag ste/ tshogs gnyis kyi rang 'bras sgyu ma lta bu'i zab gsal dbyer med kyi lha'i skur bsgom pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ ljang gu las sna tshogs padma pam̐ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan la trai yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po sku mdog gser ltar 'bar ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba'o// sku'i g.yas su rdo rje 'dzin ser po phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas rdo rje ser po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rdo rje 'dzin ma ser mo g.yas nor bu dang*/ g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi mdun du bu mo mtha' yas ma ljang gu g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon padma 'dzin pa/ 'khor de gsum zhi ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'o// g.yas kyi mdun du khye'u mtha' yas pa dmar po g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa me tog gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod gtso 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/

oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā we sha āḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas bcom ldan 'das la rnam par snad mdzad dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa chu nang gi zla ba'am me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu la yun ring du sems gzung*/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng sngags phreng gser gyi mdog can g.yas skor tu bkod pa la dran pa mngon du bzhag ste bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa shub bur bzla ste/ na ma st+rai yā dhwi kā nāṃ/ ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta wāpti/ dharma tā bā li naṃ/ aṃ a sa ma/ sa manta to/ a nanta bāpti shā sa nāṃ/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇāṃ/ bi ga tā rā ga buddha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma bā la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na ma hā wa ra ṇa/ lakṣa ṇe/ dzwa la dzwa la na sā ga re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'khor bzhi po rang la thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la bsngo ba dang smon lam spyi mthun bya/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug lha sngags 'di dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyud la brten cing rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud yin kyang sangs rgyas gsang bas bya rgyud rnams rang lugs mi mdzad par spyod rgyud du 'grel par mdzad pa ltar 'di'ang de'i rjes su 'brang bar mngon pas bdag bskyed la brten nas bsnyen pa gtong na/

bya rgyud rang lugs kyi sngon rjes la sogs pa cho ga'i chings rnams sbyor bar mi nus kyang*/ mdor bsdus yar ngo'i dus tshes bzang po la bsnyen pa'i dbu 'dzugs/ gnas khang phyag dar gtsang ma bya zhing dri chab kyis brlan/ dri bzang po'i shing ngam spos kyis bdug dkon mchog gi rten dang thub dbang gi sku gzugs bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar chu gnyis nyer spyod bsham/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung rnams bzlas pa'i chus khrus legs par bya/ gdan gtsang ma la gos gsar pa gyon nas 'dug ste/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems la gzhi bcas te srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan por gsal gdab/ sgrub thabs ltar sngon 'gro'i rim pa/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed rnams tshig tsam du ma shor bar re re bzhin gsal thebs nges su bsgom/ lha sku'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag bo dhi tsi'i bzlas phreng ras bal gyi phreng thag byas la khrus nas phyung zhing spos kyis bdugs pa blang*/ mdun du gshegs rigs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje skad cig gis gsal la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ adbhū ti bi dza ya siddhārthe swā hā/ zhes lan bdun dang*/ phreng ba snyim par bcug ste gshegs rigs kyi phreng ba'i sngags/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ siddhi sā dha ya sā dha ya/ siddhārthe swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ thun phyi ma rnams la'ang sngags gnyis pa tshar gsum re brjod/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab la yig brgya nyid ci nus bzla/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i sngags bsdus pa ni/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ ā bi ra hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa bzla/ yig brgya 'bum ther yun thung ngus mi 'grub pa sogs la'ang kha skong du sbyor chog par mngon no// bzlas pa'i mthar bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/

bdag gi bzlas brjod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub kyi don du bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo// 'phags pa khyed kyis bdag la dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ 'khor rnams rang la thim/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ ga ga ne ga ga ne/ zhes gsum dang*/ dzi na dzik /gsum brjod/ mgo bo'am snying gar zla ba la bhrūm̐ yig 'khod par bsam zhing bsngo smon byas te thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la 'jug nus na gung tshigs ma gtogs phyi dro'i kha zas spang*/ dkar gsum la sogs pa'i bza' btung rnams lugs 'di'i sngags kyis byin rlabs pa la longs spyad/ sha chang sgog btsong la phug sngo rngad 'bags lhag sogs bza' ba ma yin pa thams cad spang*/ zas zos rjes sogs la sngags btab pa'i chus khrus dang nye reg bya/ thun gyi skabs lud pa g.yal ba sbrid pa 'og rlung shor ba byung na de ma thag tu chab blangs la phreng ba'i mtshams de yan grangs la mi brtsi bar bskyar ba sogs spang blang gi gnad rgyud sde 'og ma spyi ltar shes par bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub na/ stegs bu gru bzhi ras gtsang mas g.yogs pa'i steng du maṇḍal la rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar tshom bu ser po che gcig g.yas g.yon gnyis su ser po re/ g.yas mdun dmar po/ g.yon du ljang gu rnams chung ngu re bkod/ de mdun 'bul gtor rin po che'i snod du zlum gtor rgyan ldan dkar gsum dang bcas pa/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams gtsang zhing mdzes par bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas pa sngon du btang nas 'khor bzhi rang la bsdu/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes rol mo bcas byin brlab/ dkyil 'khor bskyed chog ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi dbus su pam̐ yig ljang gu zhes pa nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod sogs nas/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes la// mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod/ bhrūm̐ dzi na dzik /shākya mu ne e hye hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis spyan drang*/ thal mo kha phye ba'i mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar bas chu gtsang me tog dang bcas te spyi bo'i thad nas phul/ padma kha phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ka ma lā ya swā hā/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ nas/ gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par bsam bar sgrub thabs ltar ro// de nas mchod pa ni/ mchod yon sbreng la/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ khrus gsol la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun bkrus gyur pa// de bzhin bdag gis lha rnams la// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba de ba ta artsi ta a mṛ ta swā hā/ nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag

/bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi// lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di// bdag gis dad pas sogs/ ā ha ra sogs/ dri yi sbyar ba lha yi rdzas// nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di// bdag gis dad= /ā ha ra= sman rnams bcud ni yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis= /ā ha ra= gnod rnams 'joms shing bkra shis la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di// bdag gis= /ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ bdag tu ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ sems can khams na gang nga yi ba med cing yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs chu dang thang las skyes pa/ rin po che'i ri dang*/ rgya mtsho'i rin po che la sogs pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchod pa'i phrin las kyis dbul bar bgyi'o// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs/ rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchog tu rgya che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog rgya chen po'i gong ma las bla mar mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab tu 'bar bar gyur cig na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa tā naṃ/ sarba thā udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ sngags 'di lan brgyad brjod/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// sogs kyis bstod de 'di ni slob dpon rin 'byung sbas pas dam tshig gsum bkod kyi bstod pa yin par bshad pas bod du ma 'gyur ba'i bya spyod kyi rgyud las 'byung bar mngon no// de nas mdun bskyed kyi sngags phreng la dmigs te yi ge brgya pa ci nus dang*/

sngags thung yang ci 'grub bzlas la/ thun mthar/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin brlab/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ.a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ rjes chog ni/ slar mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlabs la sngags spyi 'gros phul/ mnyam med mas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las rnam pa gsum dang dngos grub rnam pa gsum dang byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi bka' drin stsal nas/ mthar thug thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog par mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du'ang ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad pa dang*/ sdig pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba kha na ma tho ba med pas phyogs kun tu khyab cing rgyas pa dang*/ rnam dkar dge ba chos kyi dga' ston bla na med pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi don gyi mchog thams cad 'grub par gyur cig ces sogs 'dod don gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ lhag pa dang ni sogs bzod gsol tshig spyi 'gre/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs brjod la ye shes pa gshegs pa'ang rten yod na brtan bzhugs byas kyang rung*/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod rol mo rgya cher bya'o// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ma bshad kyang*/

'di'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i sgrub mchod phyag len mdzad pa dkon cing 'di ltar sgrub na phan yon ches che ba rgyud don las gsal phyir mdor bsdus su bkod pa yin/ 'di dag gi thun mtshams rnams su bsag sbyong gi rigs dge ba'i bya ba ci 'grub bsgrub pa dang*/ khyad par sdong po bkod pa sogs mdo sde rnams bklag mi 'grub pas kyang mdo'i glegs bam khri 'ur bkod nas phyag mchod bya dgos par gsungs so// de nas rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ bca' gzhi mdun bskyed skabs ltar la/ sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gtong*/ 'khor rnams rang la bstim/ de nas mchod pa byin brlab/ oṃ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇḍal gyi dbus su pam̐ ljang gu zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar la rang nyid ces pa dor/ dbur brgyan par gyur ces pa'i bar yang de ltar la/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ces bsgyur/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs dang*/ gsang sngags bdag dang gzungs sngags rgyal// rig rgyal rigs kyi lha mo ste// bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal// mnyes par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bzlas pa bdun tsam gyis mnyes par byas/ gtor 'bul mdun bskyed skabs su bshad pa ltar phul/ de nas mchod g.yog pas slob ma rnams la khrus kyi chab btang la gral du 'khod/ me tog bkye ba cha gnyis su byas la phyed maṇḍal du bsdus/ phyed bzung ste gsol gdab gyi dus su thal mo stong par ma song bar bya/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de'ang rang re rnams dal 'byor gyi lus rten bzang po thob pa'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ gang zhig 'bad par bya ba'i chos la'ang ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang gnas skabs gdul bya drang ba'i don du rgyal bas theg pa gsum bstan te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ thar pa zhes bya gcig pu nyid// mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro// khyod kyis theg pa gsum gsungs pa// sems can gzhug pa'i ched du lags// zhes gsungs/ theg pa gsum gang zhe na/ nyan thos kyi theg pa/ rang rgyal gyi theg pa/ theg pa chen po gsum de'i dang po gnyis ni rang don yid la byed pa can yin zhing*/ phyi ma sems can thams cad kyi ched du bya ba kho na don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ theg dman dang theg chen zhes gnyis su rnam par bzhag pa'i phyi ma la rgyu 'bras lam du byed pa'i khyad par gyis phar phyin dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su dbyer yod pa yin la/ phyi ma sngags kyi theg pa la'ang rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu bzhag 'jog du ma zhig 'byung ste/ jo bo rje'i lam sgron gyi rang 'grel las rgyud sde bdun du bzhag pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las lngar bzhag pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i sngags don rnam gzigs las gsum du bshad pa sogs mang du yod kyang*/ bzhir bzhag pa nyid grags tshod che ba'i dbang ni/ bya spyod/ rnal 'byor/ bla med rgyud de bzhi'o// de las 'dir bya ba'i rgyud la gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ padma dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum/ phal pa nor can gyi rigs/ rgyas pa'i rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te drug tu bzhugs shing*/ de rnams las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo'am bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya mo/ de bzhin gshegs rigs su bsdus pa'i byang sems/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i rgyud dang brgyad du yod pa las/ rigs kyi gtso bo dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud las byung ba bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga jo bo rje las brgyud pa dang*/

gtso 'khor lnga pa la brten nas rjes gnang bya ba'i lugs gnyis su yod pa las skabs 'dir rjes gnang bya ba yin/ de'ang yi dam lha'i sgrub thabs mang po phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ de las rgyas pa slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras bsdus pa sgrub thabs kun las btus sam/ sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa'i nang nas thog mar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la rjes gnang thob pa gal che bas/ de la nged kyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la slob mas maṇḍal phul/ yang bla mas maṇḍal phul/ thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag gi 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas byang chub kyi sems gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum dang*/ khyad par du thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ da rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ ljang gu las sogs dang*/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das thub pa zhes sogs nas/

thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gtso 'khor lnga bdag bskyed bzhin gsal gdab bo// rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi la gsum las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/ de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dril bu dang ting shags 'khrol/ rol mo bya/ spos 'grim/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis slob ma la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas bcom ldan 'das la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ser po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/

snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig na ma st+rai sogs brjod/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung pa dang*/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa rgyangs te byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'di'i rgya gzhung sgrub thabs kyi lung yang spro na bya'o// de dag ni thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa'o// de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig gzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te tshar gsum byas pas 'grub/ rjes chog ni mdun bskyed gsham du smos pa ltar bya'o// 'di'i man ngag rgyud las gsungs pa rgya chen mchis kyang phan yon che zhing phyag len thebs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la brten nas sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga la gsum/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dpyid zla ra ba la sogs pa dus khyad par can gyi zla ba gang yang rung pa'i tshes gcig gi snga ma'i nyin khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs nges pa'i mchod rten nam sku gzugs kyi nye 'khor thams cad du phyag dar legs par byas la dri zhim po'i chus chag gdab/ mdun du me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rten de dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos la snyan gsan dbab pa'i tshul du yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byas la dge ba'i sems kyis nyal lo// gnyis pa ni/ sangs tshes gcig gi nang par snga bar ldangs te mchod pa bsham/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas rten gyi spyan sngar 'khod de/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlab/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'am tha mal gyi rnam pas kyang rung ste/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po'i sems mngon du byas la/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spos btul la snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs bas/ smon lam dang thugs rje'i mthu thogs pa med pas bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis mngon sum du gshegs te mdun gyi rten dang dbyer med bzhugs par mos la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// sogs 'byon legs dang gdan phul/ khrus gsol rnams tshigs bcad rgyas pa spyi ltar bya/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar bas btud de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de rnams kyis kyang bdag la rnam pa thams cad dang dus thams cad du byin gyis brlab pa dang yongs su gzung bar gyur cig

bdag la grub pa dang mchog stsol cig /ces lan gsum gyis bdag dbul/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa sogs dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rtog pa nyid las 'byung ba ltar ram/ spyi tsam du/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa lan gsum bya/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi mthu la lhag par dad pa'i dran pa mngon du bzhag ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di bzlas pas 'khor bar gyur ba'i nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa rab tu spang ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces smon pa'i sems rtse gcig pas/ na ma st+rai ya dhwi kā nāṃ/ ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta bāpti/ dharma tā bā li nāṃ/ oṃ a/ sa ma sa ma/ sa manta to bāpti/ shā sa ni ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇe/ bi ga ta rā ga buddha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na ma hā ba ra lakṣa ṇe/ dzwā la dzwā la na sā ga re swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dag par bzlas te langs la/ skor ba'i sngags sngon du 'gro bas gzungs 'di nyid bzla bzhin du rten la bskor ba bya'o// de'i tshe mdun gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gtsug tor dang smin mtshams nas 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar 'dus rang la thim pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ ji srid ngal bar ma gyur gyi bar du bzlas brjod dang bskor ba bya'o// da lan thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ rten gyi drung du 'khod la bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ bdag gi bzlas brjod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su zhi ba'i dngos grub kyi don du bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo// 'phags pa khyed kyis bdag la sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/

ces gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam/ bum pa'i phyag rgya ni srin lag so so'i rgyab tu gung mo sbyar/ de gnyis g.yas pa'i rgyab/ g.yon pa'i mdun du sbyar te bsnol/ g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo so so gung srin la 'khyud/ mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus la bzhag mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba'o// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya/ mdun gyi lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'am/ mi dmigs par blo bzhag ste gong gi smon lam dang*/ gzhan yang bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgya cher gdab bo// de lta bu'i rim pas thun gsum mam bzhir nyams su blang*/ thun mtshams su maṇḍal sogs dge ba'i las ci 'grub dang*/ khyad par sdong po bkod pa sogs theg pa chen po'i mdo sde klog nyal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog stsol cig rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ chos kyi 'du shes kyis nyal/ ldang ba na snying rje chen po'i 'du shes kyis langs te snga ma ltar bya'o// de ltar tshes gcig nas bcu bzhi'i bar nyin dang mtshan du 'bad pa chen pos gzungs sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzla ba ni bsnyen

lan gcig gis bzlas grangs 'grub dka' bas zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la dbu bzung*/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar tshes rnams la bskyar nas grangs tshang rdzogs par grub na legs so// mchan/ pa'o// bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir rten la bskor ba ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do// de nas tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo bskor ba dang bcas pas sngags stong phrag brgyad bzla ba ni sgrub pa'o// de'i mtshan thog thag tu bzla ba ni las sbyor te/ tho rangs kyi dus su dngos sam rmi lam du/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags mthong ba ni nges pa'o// de dag gi skabs ci rigs par mdun gyi rten la khrus gsol ba'i khrus chus bdag gzhan la khrus bgyis pas sdig pa byang bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes ni/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin mo yan lag bdun pa sogs gtang rag gi mchod pa rgya cher bya zhing smon lam rgyas par gdab/ rten gyi drung du dri zhim po'i shing la me sbar te/ ku sha'i chus bsang zhing a mṛ te brjod/ ma lus sems can sogs kyis rten gyi lha thab tu spyan drangs la/ yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ til rnams gzungs sngags kho nas brgya rtsa brgyad phul sdig sgrib lhag med du byang bar gsol ba gdab/ slar rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsams la mchod cing phyag 'tshal/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dman ma rnams kyang mer bsregs te thal ba chu klung chen por dor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ spyir rten la phul ba'i me tog rnying pa gtsang sbra dang bcas te bcangs la/ char mi 'bab pa'i dus su dri zhim po'i me tog dkar po gzhan dang bcas chu klung chen por dor zhing smon lam btab pas char 'bab pa dang*/ char ha cang che ba la ba lang gi lci ba'i me la bsregs pas nam mkha' dwangs pa dang*/ 'byung pos zin pa la gu gul dang bcas te bdug pas byer ba dang*/ dud 'gro sogs dman pa'i sems can 'chi ba'i tshe dud pas bdugs na mtho ris su skye ba sogs las kyi rig pa ci yang 'grub par 'gyur ro// sbyin sreg gi tshe na'ang*/

nad zhi bar 'dod na gang na ba'i gnyer po'i sman nam/ sman des bsgos pa'i me tog gi sbyin sreg brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul la nad zhi bas mtshon rig par bya'o// 'di'i gzungs las tshes gcig nas brtsams zla ba gcig tu gsungs pa ni ji srid zla ba nya gang ba'i bar du ste dkar po'i phyogs gcig ces pa'i tha tshig go /yang gzhan du na thub pa chen po'i snying po'i sngags la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi sngon du song nas/ rgyud las de bzhin du mchod rten la bskor ba byed cing stong phrag brgyad bzlas na sdig pa las grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar bzla ba'i dus su ji skad bshad pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas nyams su blangs pas sdig pa las grol ba ni man ngag gi nges pa'o// gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bzhengs te cho ga byas la me tog la sogs pas mngon par mchod la/ mchod rten nam lugs sku la mngon du phyogs pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bdag 'bul zhing bzlas pa stong phrag brgyad byas na dam pa'i chos spong ba dang 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams byang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ chu bo'i 'gram du mchod rten byas la chu bo'i nang du ske nub tsam du zhugs nas/ bzlas pa byas na las sgrib thams cad zad par 'gyur ba dang*/ dben par mig btsums te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs nas mig btsums pa de kho nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid kyis mthong bar 'gyur ba de srid du bzlas pa byas na sdig pa'i las kyi sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mi smra bar stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur zhing dam chos thams cad kyang shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ nyin re bzhin ma chag par bzlas nas phyogs de bsrung bar byas par 'gyur ba dang byang chub sems kyi sa bon 'phel zhing mi nyams par rgyas par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa rgyud nyid las 'byung ngo*// de thams cad du'ang thog mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs nas phyag bya/

sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed/ 'gyod pa dang zhum pa'i sems spang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang rjes su yi rang ba rgyun mi bcad/ dad pa dang ldan zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la gus shing bstan pa la ched cher byed pa/ 'du 'dzi spong ba rnams kyis myur du 'grub cing*/ dad pa med pa dang byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pas ni 'grub par mi 'gyur bar gsungs so// 'di sgrub pa la gegs dang bar chad ni nam yang med cing*/ bya rgyud spyi ltar gyi gtsang sbra'i kun spyod med kyang 'grub par gsungs te rgyud nyid las/ thogs pa med pa/ don yod par grub pa'i snying po 'di yang bsod nams dang ldan pa'am/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pas kyang rung 'grub 'gyur ro// tshul khrims dang ldan pa yang rung*/ tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// thabs dang ldan pa'am thabs dang mi ldan pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// mkhas kyang rung mi mkhas kyang rung nges par don yod par 'gyur ro// gzhan du dad pa med pa dang byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa rnams kyis ma yin no// bris sku med kyang rung*/ mchod kyang rung mchod pa med kyang rung*/ khrus la sogs pa med kyang rung*/ phyi'i spyod pa gtsang spra la sogs pa med kyang rung*/ nya sha dang sha dag la sogs pa yongs su ma spangs kyang rung 'grub par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs pa bsgoms pa'i sems kyis 'grub bo// zhes gsungs so// thub chen thugs rje gzungs sngags nus pa'i stobs// dus mtha'i zhugs kyis bdag gzhan 'gro rgyud kyi// sgrib pa'i tshang tshing lhag med rab sbyangs te// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /'di nyid kyi stod cha mngon rtogs tsam rje bla ma rin po che nyid kyis mdzad nas 'phro lus su gyur pa/ rje btsun bka' drin mtshungs med mchog de'i dgongs pa skong ba'i slad du 'du gsum pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos sngar 'phros rdzogs par tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel//
